turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why am I here? Owen's essay got a zero, and nobody called me first.
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Recording. Then you'll send me a copy tonight, and I'll be recording too. Now, who decided on the zero?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.
Nobody has mentioned legal action. I asked who decided on the zero.
Hale, I choose them carefully for a living. Who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
